text: The gateway runs the password through Argon2id, a memory-hard hashing function.

text: Memory-hard means that every single check needs a real block of memory and real time.

text: For the gateway, that is one check per login.

text: For an attacker with a stolen copy of the table, every guess costs the same, so millions of guesses become very slow and very expensive.

text: Before the hashing, the gateway adds a salt: random bytes, new for each password.
